article.title: Charge of tax in the case of a firm.
article.content: In the case of a firm which is assessable as a firm, tax shall be charged on its total income at the rate as specified in the Finance Act of the relevant year.
article.html:
167ACharge of tax in the case of a firm.

Section 167A · Chapter XV · DD.—Firms, association of persons and body of individuals · page 678 of the Act

In the case of a firm which is assessable as a firm, tax shall be charged on its total income at the rate as specified in the Finance Act of the relevant year.
